# Projects 🚀

Here are the projects I've worked on — combining data, code, and curiosity.

---

## 🏎️ F1 SQL Analysis
::: {.card style="padding: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;"}

**Tools:** SQL, R

Explored Formula 1 racing data using SQL queries to extract and analyze
driver performance, race results, and championship standings. Combined
SQL with R to visualize key insights from decades of F1 history.

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-f72585?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kho2934)

:::

## 📝 Journal Text Analysis
::: {.card style="padding: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;"}

**Tools:** R, Tidytext, ggplot2

Performed text mining and sentiment analysis across 3 academic journals.
Used natural language processing techniques to identify themes, word
frequencies, and emotional tone across different publications.

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-f72585?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kho2934)

:::

## 🎨 aRtpalette Package
::: {.card style="padding: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;"}

**Tools:** R, devtools, ggplot2

Independently designed and built **aRtpalette** — an R package that provides
curated color palettes for data visualization. Inspired by art and aesthetics,
this package makes it easy to create beautiful, cohesive plots in R.

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-f72585?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kho2934)

:::
